status_effects.explanation: He is drawn into the duchess's direct attention and conversation, a small, staged inclusion in valued social space.

His visible, anxious effort to hold his aunt's attention and sustain the talk marks him as dependent and uneasy in this exchange, a mild diminishment relative to the ease of her spontaneous attention to the narrator.

appraisal_events.evidence: Bonjour, comment allez-vous ? me dit-elle. Elle laissa pleuvoir sur moi la lumière de son regard bleu...
appraisal_events.explanation: The duchess turns from Saint-Loup to address the narrator directly and confers her attention on him, staging him as a participant momentarily included in her favor.

appraisal_events.evidence: faisait à distance des efforts désespérés pour obtenir un peu plus encore de sa tante. Craignant que la conversation ne tombât, il vint l'alimenter et répondit pour moi
appraisal_events.explanation: Saint-Loup is described as anxiously straining to secure a little more attention from his own aunt and rushing to prop up a flagging conversation, a mildly ironic picture of effortful dependency rather than easy command of the exchange.
